Name: (CP) Froggy Bucket Hat for 1.6
Author: kirbysteaks
Description:
[center]This mod adds a Froggy bucket hat for sale from the Hat Mouse. Based on the vanilla bucket hat textures from 1.6.
Available for sale from the Hat Mouse.

[url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url][url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles][/url][url=https://emojipedia.org/frog]🐸[/url]✨

Froggy Bucket Hat does not replace any existing vanilla hats.

Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.[/center]
[center]✨[/center]
[center]Special thanks to the friends in the SV Disocrd server modding channels for helping me fight my bugs on this, my maiden modding voyage.[/center]
